_: The machine-readable story sheet. docs/STORY_SHEET.md is its human copy; tests/story-order.cjs reads THIS file and walks the real build against it. One row per story beat, in canon order (docs/STORY_CANON.md). requires = flags that must already be set when the beat becomes possible; sets = flags it sets; optional = a beat the route may legitimately skip (it is still checked whenever it does happen); key = for a standing line, the line the production selector must pick; when = the production predicate that decides the beat can happen inside its room (absent = being able to reach the room is enough); lines = i18n keys (or @dynamic selectors) the speaker says at that moment; introduces = names this beat presents for the first time. pointer = who or what sends the player there — never empty.

beats.speaker: none (tutorial chip)
beats.knows: Nothing. She wakes alone in a service cradle; sleep is why she missed the broadcast.
beats.pointer: Tutorial chip: Move — walk right toward the light (tut_move)

beats.speaker: none (tutorial chip)
beats.knows: The city is standing and silent.
beats.pointer: Tutorial chip at the road's end: the gates — stand beneath them and press UP

beats.speaker: Ratchet (his letter)
beats.knows: Mother's song is infected; his marble slowed the virus; he removed his own battery; it is in the drawer.
beats.pointer: Tutorial chip on the waking floor: Read Ratchet's note — the booth door opens in the street wall (tut_note)

beats.speaker: Ratchet
beats.knows: An unknown intruder infected Mother's song; his inherited marble slowed it; she was asleep, not immune; raw marble lies in the caves beneath the meadow and he can forge a cleansing sword from it; Servo needs the spare cell; the way down is the loose floor at the hub's west end.
beats.pointer: His own letter: the battery is in the drawer beside this chair (sl_note2)

beats.speaker: Ratchet
beats.knows: The pack wires repair and the Volt Burst; the ring is empty until she earns volts.
beats.pointer: Ratchet: 'come to my counter. I keep a volt pack' (sl_heal_gift); tutorial chip: Buy a volt cell

beats.speaker: Old Servo
beats.knows: His receiver was unplugged when the song changed; the gantries; how to move, jump, strike and mend — on her own controls.
beats.pointer: Ratchet: 'I left a spare cell for Servo in your pouch. His gantries overlook the meadow' (q_ask_ratchet_forge)

beats.speaker: NULLFANG (never speaks)
beats.pointer: The road itself: the hub is the only way east, and the guardian drops onto its crest unasked

beats.speaker: Ratchet
beats.knows: The lion threw her; claws will not answer it; the marble comes first.
beats.pointer: Returning to the workshop after the corridor

beats.speaker: the terminal under the hub
beats.knows: A sub-hatch was sealed after an anomalous signal.
beats.pointer: Ratchet: the loose floor at the hub's west end, strike straight down (q_where_ratchet_forge); the break_down hint over the loose rock

beats.speaker: the Deaf System's log
beats.knows: The deaf survived the song underground and quarried this seam.
beats.pointer: The sound through the rock since the meadow, and the rubble that answers a strike

beats.speaker: none (pl_hint)
beats.knows: Claws glance off raw marble; the charged burst frees it.
beats.pointer: Ratchet: raw marble in the caves beneath the meadow (q_ask_ratchet_forge); pl_hint at the stone

beats.speaker: Ratchet
beats.knows: He shapes the marble into the PURIFIER, then moves his tools to the camp by the lion's enclosure.
beats.pointer: Ratchet's own errand: bring a piece back to my workshop (q_ask_ratchet_forge)

beats.speaker: Ratchet (at the camp)
beats.knows: The first Sage is behind the maintenance passage beside the quarry; clear their binding before the guardian.
beats.pointer: Ratchet himself, at the forge: 'Find me there' (sl_ratchet_moving)

beats.speaker: THE ALPHA (no words)
beats.knows: Optional: the pack follows its guardian; the white blade releases it.
beats.pointer: Ratchet's optional errand at the forge (q_ask_alpha_pack); the den's marked entrance in the hub (alpha_den)

beats.speaker: The Meadow Sage
beats.knows: Its calling betrayed hidden survivors; NULLFANG resists; CHIME rewrites the order — or, in whatever order she arrives, that the bell is already silent or the lion already free.
beats.pointer: Ratchet: 'The maintenance passage beside the marble quarry leads to the first Sage' (sl_ratchet_forged); gh_sage at the lair door

beats.speaker: Ratchet (at the camp)
beats.knows: Word that the sage stood up clean.
beats.pointer: The camp is on the road back from the quarry to the lair

beats.speaker: CHIME (no words)
beats.knows: It is an instrument with nobody in it; while it rings, NULLFANG's binding is rewritten.
beats.pointer: The Meadow Sage: 'Take the climb above the meadow. Silence that bell' (sg_rev4); gh_chime at the lair door; the climb itself is warded shut until the Sage is free (gate_chime_ward, ward_chime_fall)

beats.speaker: NULLFANG (never speaks)
beats.knows: He resists; the bell writes the order back.
beats.pointer: The Meadow Sage's route: the climb rises out of the hub's west end, where he comes out; the camp's east end for a player who walks on

beats.speaker: Ratchet (at the camp)
beats.knows: The lion is winnable now: go and put a dent in it.
beats.pointer: The camp is the last room before the lair

beats.speaker: NULLFANG (never speaks)
beats.pointer: The Meadow Sage: 'return to his enclosure' (sg_rev4 / sg_rev_go); Ratchet at the camp (sl_ratchet_rematch)

beats.speaker: Ratchet (at the camp)
beats.knows: The hatch above the camp unjammed when the lion was freed; the climb leads to the Data Conduits.
beats.pointer: conduits_open, said the moment NULLFANG is free

beats.speaker: none
beats.knows: The second kingdom.
beats.pointer: Ratchet: 'That climb goes up into the Data Conduits' (sl_ratchet_conduits); conduits_open; gate_conduits whenever the hatch refuses

beats.speaker: Mono
beats.knows: The order comes up from beneath the Archives in Mother's voice — her voice, not her command.
beats.pointer: The Oracle's parlour door, the only door on the conduit corridor (B3)

beats.speaker: TALONHOST (no words)
beats.pointer: The conduit corridor runs east from the Oracle straight into her hall

beats.speaker: the Prism Prowler (no words)
beats.knows: It was never infected; it guards the seam's second blade and stands down.
beats.pointer: Mono: 'Cracked walls hide old maintenance shafts. Strike them' — B5's breakable ceiling

beats.knows: The last seal of the old vault lies on a ledge in the Foundry tower.
beats.pointer: Patch-7 in the pour gallery: 'The walls hum near the old vault...'; the sealed vault itself, refused without it: 'The third seal was carried down into the Foundry tower.' (vault_where3)

beats.speaker: Kerf
beats.knows: Her harvesters' marble is the stone Ratchet wears; she shaped the second edge; the Prowler keeps it, clean.
beats.pointer: Vault Sigil I: 'One of three seals of an old vault in the Conduits' (rl_sigil1d); the vault counts its sigils (vault_locked)

beats.speaker: FURNACE CHOIR (no words)

beats.speaker: The Nine-Lives Sage
beats.knows: GLACIERE sleeps beyond the ice and guards the Kernel Key.

beats.speaker: GLACIERE (no words)
